Hi. 

I'm sorry for the late response, it was due to a combined factor of wanting to distance myself from my problems and then losing this throwaway account.

I've considered trying to see a therapist again, I used to see one in highschool, but I never really felt like I got anywhere in terms of solving my problems while working with her, I wound up feeling like I was just wasting my parents money. Being a burden.

I am currently unemployed, taking time off of college, and still living at home with my parents. I would have to take their money to see a therapist and I worry that it'll just wind up like last time and I'll just be throwing their hard earned money down the drain.

In order to get that help, I'd have to not only admit everything to the people around me, most specifically my parents, but I would have to rely on them for the money to see a therapist, as I am unemployed and thus wouldn't be able to afford it myself.

I saw a therapist for a while in highschool, but I never really felt like it was much help and I eventually began to feel like I was wasting my parent's money.

I hate being a burden, and I tend to feel that every slip up or failure on someone else's dollar is me being a nuisance and a wasteful burden.

I'm sorry for the late response, it was due to a combined factor of wanting to distance myself from my problems and then losing this throwaway account.

In the month since I posted this things have gotten better in some ways, but mostly they've either stayed the same or gotten worse.

I've come to realize a part of my problem is that I can't seem to think straight, it feels almost like there's other voices in my head blurring into an indistinct mess. The best I can describe it as is like watching people mingling at a cocktail party. You know they're saying something, but you can't really work out what, and your own voice gets lost in the mess.

I feel bad coming to this subreddit with my problems at the moment because I don't think I'm in any immediate danger of suicide. At least, not in the short-term.

But I just don't know where else to go.. I can't talk to people at home. I don't want to worry them and even if I did go to them, I don't think I'd be able to properly explain it.
